entities.name: Mieszko I & Baptism of Poland
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Mieszko I unified the Polanie and neighbouring tribes, adopted Christianity through the Baptism of Poland (966), and established the Gniezno diocese. His Dagome iudex document placed Poland under papal protection.
